highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves rendering reliability while reducing allocations in image and text-processing paths.
highlights_body: It synchronizes Android texture rendering with display refresh, bundles required WebGPU native support, and fixes retained front-buffered stream data.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows display refresh
bullets.detail: Texture-backed Android rendering is synchronized with display refresh to provide smoother presentation.

bullets.lead: Managed pixel transfers use fewer allocations
bullets.detail: Image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary managed allocations while preserving their existing behavior.
Feature-string handling avoids native temporary allocations, and HarfBuzz text shaping pools its UTF-32 encoding buffer.
Front-buffered stream handling no longer retains data after it is no longer needed.
The WebGPU implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a so native consumers receive the required WebGPU support with the library.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bundled the native WebGPU implementation in libSkiaSharp.a
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Improved the reliability of Blazor CPU sample tests by waiting for the first canvas paint
